draft.shortGloss: to see; to notice; to think
draft.emotion: matter-of-fact, observing something as it naturally happens
notes: Do not confuse with มอง (mɔɔng, 'to look at'), which is directing your eyes intentionally; เห็น is when something enters your sight.
Often follows มอง as a result complement: มองเห็น ('able to see') and มองไม่เห็น ('unable to see').

senses.definition: To perceive or notice something with your eyes.

examples.text: ฉันเห็นนกตัวหนึ่งบนต้นไม้
examples.translation: I see a bird in the tree.
examples.emotion: calm and observant, noting a detail in the environment

senses.definition: To hold an opinion or view about something, usually followed by ว่า ('that').

examples.text: ฉันเห็นว่ามันแพงเกินไป
examples.translation: I think that it is too expensive.
examples.emotion: decisive and firm, stating a personal viewpoint
